Once me and my dad where on our way to my grandparent's house. It's down through a little town called Rutherfordton, and basically there are some older buildings that are abandoned. We had joked about heading there since he said time and again that he knew an old man who had the keys to the property, we had passed it for years, but I was a little older now and literally just had time to kill on this day so I said sure.

He pulled up to the house, off the side of the "main" road, and I got my phone out to record my experience. I got out the truck and made my way across the street, and then at that moment my dad hit the gas and drove all the way down the road leaving me, then turned back and started laughing. Thanks dad. Anyways I decided to continue forth and got a couple good shots inside the house and even a video which I wish I could say I had for to upload and show you guys, but in the video is the weirdest thing. First off there was no wind that day, it was when we still had nice cool / warm summers with a light breeze in North Carolina, and my dad had killed the ignition, and there was no traffic on this back road. So basically there are no sounds coming from ANYWHERE.

I film the entire house, from front porch to back, and get a look upstairs (from the outside) (it's a two story) and I almost walk on the deck but decide to leave at that point. So I get back into he truck and begin to watch the video and look at the images on my old Versa phone. I got some nice pics but when I played the video back with the volume on. I began to hear sounds, noises I can't make out. Words rather and I'm not sure what but in my confusion it could have either said "leave" or "help" either way it was a bit wispy and "distorted" but not like... Technologically. Also while rewatching many times I began to make out a face online visible on my phone camera, now at the time it wasn't the best cam on a phone sure. BUT you could see everything else in near crisp detail at that point in time, and I was sure I saw moment on the top floor. Along with the audio which should have not been there and a moving object and or face in the window. I can honestly say this is the closest I've been to deciding AT THE VERY LEAST, that it's something I cannot explain and COULD have been something paranormal.

Thanks for reading.
